name: MultiModal Chart Benchmark (MMC-Benchmark)
description: MMC-Benchmark is a comprehensive human-annotated benchmark with nine distinct tasks designed to evaluate reasoning capabilities over charts, addressing the gap in multimodal chart image understanding.
reputation: A recent chart-reasoning benchmark that has been cited in multimodal reasoning work but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes 600k instruction tuning instances and evaluates large multimodal models on chart understanding tasks.
